description: Put a hidden post back in the user's Chirpie listings. The exact undo of chirpie_hide_post, and as with hide, nothing reaches the platform. Unhiding a post that was never hidden succeeds and changes nothing. chirpie_list_posts with include_hidden true lists the hidden posts.

id.description: Post ID to show again. A thread or fan-out moves whole.

name: chirpie_unhide_post
title: Unhide a post in Chirpie
